body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Suppress 1 point of equipment Fortitude bonus for this attack. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus as well.
On a hit, keep the suppressed equipment bonus unavailable against the next ranged attack before your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Targeting
rider.html: After a hit on a Locked target, you may end Lock to prevent it from gaining new ordinary cover benefits against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn. Solid cover still blocks targeting.
